text:
helen (People Ops): heads up - multiple reports that the new interviewer training Looms uploaded last week have no captions/transcripts visible in the ATS player. accessibility flagged by 3 folks.
omar (Interview Enablement): ah, I disabled auto-captions while we tested a new export flow. did we forget to re-enable?
lin (Recruiter): candidates flagged that some interviewers rely on transcripts for note-taking. also, new interviewers with hearing impairments need captions during prep sessions.
todd (Hiring Manager): this matters for our calibration workshop tomorrow. can we get captions asap or at least upload the VTTs manually?
caption-bot: captioning-job:loom-2026-04 started at 1777653000 for asset training-2026-Q2-1. status: FAILED missing webhook callback.
omar (Interview Enablement): checking loom admin: the export flow posts a webhook to /webhooks/captions which hit 504 last week during deploy. I can re-run caption exports manually for the 6 affected videos.
helen (People Ops): would prefer a short-term UI banner in ATS for interviewers: "If you need captions/transcript, download PDF transcript from Admin > Training" until fixed.
lin (Recruiter): +1. Also can we notify the cohort who signed up for tomorrow's session? I'll DM the invitees.
omar (Interview Enablement): manual re-export + attach VTTs will take ~45m. I can ask Nate from Eng-ops for a small script to attach VTTs in bulk.
todd (Hiring Manager): if manual attach isn't done by EOD please surface a backup plan: run live captions in Zoom during the calibration session.
helen (People Ops): agreed. I'll draft a one-paragraph comm and post to #people-ops once banner goes live. Template: "We're aware of missing captions on some training videos; captions are being reattached. If you need immediate access, contact People Ops or use live captions in Zoom"
omar (Interview Enablement): started manual re-exports at 1777654390. will update with counts. added instrumentation ticket to log webhook failures and video_id.
caption-bot: ticket created: CAP-2026-12 "loom-caption-callback-504" assigned to omar.
lin (Recruiter): thanks - tested candidate-facing transcript for training-2026-Q2-1 after reattach, captions display correctly now. ping me when all 6 are done and I'll notify interviewers.
helen (People Ops): verified banner up and comm sent at 1777654521. thanks team!"
